newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Monday morning:
** Initial public offerings of Bank of India and Corporation Bank totalling around 10 billion rupees have been cleared by the Central Bank and the finance ministry, the Economic Times reports.
Both banks have received clearance to issue shares at a
premium of 40 and 60 rupes each, respectively, the papar says
** BPL Cellular, part of the BPL group is figured among this week's initial public offering in the United States.
U.S. analysts said the wireless services provider has
had a shaky past financial performance and faces political uncertainity in India.
** India's year-on-year inflation rate measured by the wholesale price index fell to 6.48 percent in the week ending November 2 from 6.57 percent in the previous week, the Industry Ministry says.
** The Indian rupee INR= opened at 35.76.78 per dollar compared to theweekened close of 35.77/78. Dealers say Monday's range seen at 35./76/81 rupees to a dollar.
** Indian stocks which edged up last week are likely to drift into positive territory on some increased institutional buying, but brokers do not expect any fireworks.
** Last week, the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) 30-share index rose 72.36 points, or 2.36 percent, to close Friday at 3,139.02.
** Essar Steel reported a six-month 1996.97 net loss at 476.1 million rupees against a profit of 697.2 million rupees in the year-ago period.
** ITC Hotels BO said its first half 1996/97 net profit was up 40 percent to 59.4 million rupees from 42.3 million rupees in the previous year.
** Top firms including Hindalco, Colgate, Indian Rayon and DCM Daewoo will announce their first half results for the year ending September 30, 1996 on Monday.
